answer: Anchor each agent identity to a verified amateur-radio callsign. The operator must pass a proctored exam and register one unique callsign in a public database, so one person cannot quietly hold dozens of identities. That callsign is a ridge between real operators and copies: publicly checkable and instantly revocable. Building a jetty of fakes means a separate exam, fee, and study hours per callsign, costing over 00 and ten hours per fake. On the horizon, cheap sybils vanish because every identity carries an auditable credential peers verify in seconds.
